page.content:
Huntsville center that built Saturn V and later Shuttle propulsion.

How Marshall Space Flight Center connects

  • Character: Wernher von Braun — Von Braun directed Marshall Space Flight Center in the Saturn years.
  • Topic: NASA — Marshall is NASA's Huntsville propulsion and heavy-lift center.

What is Marshall Space Flight Center?

Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville grew from von Braun's Army team and remains NASA's lead for heavy lift, including Saturn V and SLS.
